Peralasthalamāhātmya

Periyappā_Kavi
son of Patañjalasūri alias Aṇṇāśāstrin an. Lakṣmī an. grandson [Page196-b] of Kṛṣṇa; contemporary of Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita.
--Śṛṅgāramañjarīśāharājīya. on a love theme pertaining to king Śāhaji.

Perudīkṣita
son of Lakṣmaṇārya of Paṭṭasa family.
--C. Mantrakairava on Devīmāhātmya.

Perubhaṭṭa
alias Perama Bhaṭṭa; father an. preceptor of Jagannātha Paṇḍita (a. of Rasagaṅgādhara etc.); pupil of Jñānendra Bhikṣu, Mahendra Khaṇḍadeva an. Śeṣa Vīreśvara. See Rasagaṅgādhara
